slides.title: Two go-live waves in 24 weeks, each gated

node.text: A 24-week program moves scheduling, registration and billing at Northfield onto one set of workflows, live in two waves.

node.label: W1–W7 · 11 Jan – 26 Feb
node.title: Assess and design
node.body: Baseline, future-state design and business case.

node.label: W8–W14 · 1 Mar – 16 Apr
node.title: Build and test
node.body: Configure, integrate and prove it in UAT.

node.label: W15–W24 · 19 Apr – 25 Jun
node.title: Deploy and stabilize
node.body: Two go-live waves, then four weeks of hypercare.

node.text: Team, governance and plan in place.
Steering committee approves the future state.
Workflows, rules and interfaces unit tested.
No open severity 1 or 2 defects remain.
Central scheduling and two hospitals go live.
Remaining hospitals and clinics go live.
